name: Al(2009)-15%SiC(w) MMC powder
process_note: [D] powder metallurgy: vacuum hot-pressed above solidus, then extruded/hot-rolled (NASA TM-102694 materials section, supplier ACMC). Not a casting or AM route; SiC whisker powder is a respirable-fibre hazard [Y].

sources.rho: [Y] rule of mixtures 0.85*2.80 (2009 matrix, unverified) + 0.15*3.21 (SiC, unverified) = 2.86 g/cm3
sources.E: [D] 92-115 GPa (low end T-L 6.35 mm sheet), NASA TM-102694 (Birt & Johnson, Jul 1990), https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900016766/downloads/19900016766.pdf, Table II (report p.19)
sources.Fy: [D] 182 MPa = lowest PROPORTIONAL LIMIT (not 0.2% offset; paper says 0.2% offset not representative), range 182-237 MPa, as-fabricated, NASA TM-102694 (Birt & Johnson, Jul 1990), https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900016766/downloads/19900016766.pdf, Table II (report p.19)
sources.Fu: [D] 325-574 MPa (low end T-L 3.18 mm), NASA TM-102694 (Birt & Johnson, Jul 1990), https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900016766/downloads/19900016766.pdf, Table II (report p.19)
sources.K1c: NOT FOUND (Lee/Kim/Kwon, Metall. Trans. A 25 (1994) 2213, https://www.osti.gov/biblio/6995957 abstract: 2009/SiC/15w tougher than 2124/SiC/15w; T4P tougher than overaged; no number in abstract)

notes: Room-temperature, as-fabricated data only; anisotropic L-T vs T-L. 2xxx matrix overages above ~150-200 C [Y], so >300 C service is doubtful and unverified. Elongation 2.6-6.2 %.

name: Aluminum, 8009, rapid solidification
process_note: [D] conventional route is RS powder metallurgy (Al-8.5Fe-1.3V-1.7Si PM, extruded), Porr & Gangloff, NASA-UVA LA2ST report N90-22653, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900013337/downloads/19900013337.pdf p.1-2; [S-snippet] crack-free SLM parts at 320 W, 1000 mm/s, 0.10 mm hatch with pre-heating (Sun et al., J. Mater. Res. 2015, doi 10.1557/jmr.2015.110; abstract seen only via search snippet). AM = research level. Not conventionally castable (needs rapid solidification to keep dispersoids fine) [Y].

sources.rho: [S-snippet] theoretical density 2.92 g/cm3 quoted in an SLM study (search snippet, paper not opened)
sources.E: [Y] ~88 GPa recollection for dispersoid-strengthened Al-Fe-V-Si; NOT verified this session (ASM Alloy Digest Al-298 paywalled)
sources.Fy: [D] ~395 MPa at 25 C, extruded FVS0812, read off Yield-Strength-vs-T figure, Porr & Gangloff, NASA-UVA LA2ST report N90-22653, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900013337/downloads/19900013337.pdf PDF p.19 (+/-5 MPa digitising)
sources.Tmax: [D-abstract] retains properties after 100 h and 1000 h at up to 589 K (316 C): Go & Wilshire, Scripta Metall. Mater. 26 (1992), https://www.osti.gov/biblio/5654180; [S-snippet] 'designed for high temperature (up to 400 C)' (Welding of RS alloy 8009 paper, snippet only)
sources.K1c: [D] LT 36.6 MPa m^0.5 at 25 C; LT minimum 14.6 at 200 C; TL 16.1 at 25 C falling to 9.5 at 316 C; abstract p.2, Porr & Gangloff, NASA-UVA LA2ST report N90-22653, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900013337/downloads/19900013337.pdf
sources.strength_300C_ratio: [D] YS ~273 MPa at 316 C / ~395 MPa at 25 C = 0.69, same figure p.19, Porr & Gangloff, NASA-UVA LA2ST report N90-22653, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19900013337/downloads/19900013337.pdf

notes: K1c entered is TL at 25 C (worse orientation). WARNING: TL K1c at 316 C = 9.5 MPa m^0.5 < 10 threshold; dynamic strain ageing gives a toughness minimum at ~200 C. AMS 4309 (8009-H112 extrusions) exists [S, https://saemobilus.sae.org/content/AMS4309, not opened]. Fu and E unverified.
